sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: DOMINANT PLNS RIDGE WILL AMPLIFY FARTHER NE ACROSS THE UPR MS VLY/UPR GRT LKS THIS PERIOD AS POTENT GRT BASIN SHORTWAVE TROUGH EJECTS ENE TO THE CNTRL HI PLNS. AT THE SAME TIME...BROAD...LOW AMPLITUDE CYCLONIC FLOW WILL PREVAIL OVER WRN CANADA WHILE QUE CLOSED LOW EDGES SLOWLY E AND DEVOLVES INTO AN OPEN TROUGH. AT LWR LVLS...COLD FRONT NOW EXTENDING FROM WRN ND SW TO THE NRN GRT BASIN SHOULD PROGRESS STEADILY E/SE...REACHING A NW MN...SW SD...NRN UT LINE BY EVE...AND A NRN MN...CNTRL NEB...CNTRL CO LINE BY 12Z FRI. AHEAD OF THE FRONT...LEE TROUGH NOW EXTENDING FROM CNTRL SD TO SE CO EXPECTED TO MOVE MORE SLOWLY EWD...ITS NRN PART BEING OVERTAKEN BY THE COLD FRONT IN SD AND NRN NEB TONIGHT/EARLY FRI.

sections.title: CNTRL RCKYS TO CNTRL/NRN HI PLNS
sections.text: HIGH-BASED TSTMS NOW OVER UT SHOULD MOVE/DEVELOP NE ACROSS WRN/NRN CO AND THE MOUNTAINS OF WY TODAY AS GRT BASIN UPR VORT ACCELERATES ENEWD. THE MEAN LWR TROPOSPHERIC FLOW AHEAD OF THIS FEATURE WILL NOT BE QUITE AS STRONG AS IT WAS YESTERDAY...BUT WILL PROVIDE SUFFICIENT BACKGROUND MOMENTUM TO AUGMENT DMGG WIND POTENTIAL OF DIURNALLY ENHANCED STORMS FORMING DOWNSTREAM ACROSS CO/WY. STRONG SFC HEATING/DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER WILL FOSTER CONVECTIVELY INDUCED DOWNDRAFTS. GIVEN SOMEWHAT GREATER MOISTURE AVAILABILITY RELATIVE TO YESTERDAY /PW AROUND .75 INCH/...AND PRESENCE OF AMPLE CLOUD LAYER FLOW/LARGE SCALE ASCENT...THERE IS A GOOD CHANCE THAT THE STORMS WILL ORGANIZE INTO CLUSTERS/BANDS. THESE COULD REACH THE VERY DEEPLY-MIXED ENVIRONMENT OF THE CNTRL HI PLNS BY EVE...WHERE ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT LIKELY WILL OCCUR. THE LATTER ACTIVITY MAY INCLUDE A FEW SUPERCELLS...ESPECIALLY OVER NE WY/SW SD IN WAKE OF AFOREMENTIONED COLD FRONT...WHERE MOIST NELY UPSLOPE FLOW WILL ENLARGE LOW LVL HODOGRAPHS/ENHANCE SHEAR.

sections.title: NRN PLNS/UPR MS VLY LATER TODAY THROUGH TNGT
sections.text: A CONDITIONAL THREAT FOR SIGNIFICANT SVR WEATHER WILL EXIST INVOF COLD FRONT/PRE FRONTAL TROUGH FROM SD NEWD INTO ERN ND AND WRN/NRN MN. SFC HEATING OF VERY MOIST AIR /PW AOA 1.75 INCHES WITH SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LWR 70S F/ BENEATH DEEP EML WILL BOOST SBCAPE TO AROUND 5000 J PER KG...BUT WITH A SUBSTANTIAL CAP. LOW LVL WINDS IN THE FRONTAL ZONE WILL BE WEAK...LIMITING HODOGRAPH SIZE AND CONVERGENCE. BUT PROGRESSIVE NATURE OF FRONT /DUE LARGELY TO DISTURBANCES IN CYCLONIC FLOW OVER SW CANADA/...FRONTAL UPLIFT...AND SFC HEATING MAY PROVE SUFFICIENT TO BREACH CAP AND INITIATE ISOLD STORMS LATE THIS AFTN OR EARLY THIS EVE...ESPECIALLY IN ERN ND/NW MN COUPLED WITH 40-50 KT DEEP SWLY SHEAR ON WRN SIDE OF AMPLIFYING RIDGE...SETUP COULD YIELD SUPERCELLS WITH VERY LARGE HAIL AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO OR TWO DESPITE WEAK SRH. IF STORMS DO INDEED FORM...THEY COULD EVOLVE INTO A SMALL BUT INTENSE CLUSTER WITH AN ATTENDANT DMGG WIND...HAIL...AND HEAVY RAIN THREAT CONTINUING ENE ACROSS NRN MN TNGT.

sections.title: WI/MI
sections.text: ELEVATED CONVECTION/ACCAS MAY PERSIST OVER WI/UPR MI TODAY...ON ERN FLANK OF BUILDING/ELONGATING UPR RIDGE AND ASSOCIATED EML. A CONDITIONAL THREAT WILL EXIST THAT...WITH TIME...THE ACTIVITY WILL DEVELOP BASES LOW ENOUGH TO POSE A RISK OF SVR HAIL. BUT BUILDING OF RIDGE SUGGESTS THAT THE GREATER THREAT FOR SUCH DEVELOPMENT MAY WAIT UNTIL TNGT/EARLY FRI AS LLJ STRENGTHENS AND VEERS TO WSWLY WITH THE CONTINUED SW-NE ELONGATION OF UPR RIDGE. GIVEN MOISTURE AVAILABILITY IN THE LLJ...AND DEEP EML...SETUP COULD SUPPORT UPSCALE DEVELOPMENT INTO ONE OR TWO SMALL CLUSTERS THAT POSE A THREAT FOR VERY LARGE HAIL SEWD INTO WRN/SRN LWR MI AND PERHAPS NRN IND BY 12Z FRI.

sections.title: DEEP S TX TODAY
sections.text: MODERATE...VERTICALLY VEERING...VERY MOIST LWR TROPOSPHERIC FLOW ON NRN FRINGE OF T.S. ARLENE MAY PROVE SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT AT LEAST WEAK LOW LVL ROTATION IN CONVECTION/STORMS CROSSING DEEP S TX TODAY. ANY ASSOCIATED TORNADO THREAT SHOULD REMAIN ISOLD/CONDITIONAL...AND DIMINISH TNGT.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE TODAY
sections.text: SFC HEATING OF WEAKLY CONFLUENT LOW LVL ENVIRONMENT OVER S GA/N FL MAY SUPPORT SCTD PULSE STORMS WITH A COUPLE INSTANCES OF LOCALLY DMGG WIND TODAY. ISOLD PULSE STORMS ALSO MAY OCCUR THIS AFTN IN LOW LVL MOISTURE AXIS N OF STALLED FRONT IN AR/ERN OK...WHERE VERY STEEP LOW LVL LAPSE RATES COULD YIELD AN ISOLD WET MICROBURST. BUT WEAK FLOW AT ALL LVLS WILL LIMIT DURATION/PROPAGATION OF SUCH ACTIVITY. ..CORFIDI/GRAMS.. 06/30/2011

sections.title: CNTRL ROCKIES INTO NRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: POTENT VORTICITY MAXIMUM OVER SWRN UT WILL PROGRESS ENEWD ACROSS THE REGION THROUGH THE D1 PERIOD WITH A CORRIDOR OF MODEST HEIGHT FALLS AND 40-50+ KT FLOW AT 500 MB ATTENDING THIS SYSTEM. 12Z REGIONAL SOUNDINGS SHOWED THE PRESENCE OF A STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT PRECEDING THE VORTICITY MAXIMUM AND ASSOCIATED SURFACE COLD FRONT WITH DAYTIME HEATING AND PW VALUES OF 0.70-0.90 INCH SUPPORTING AFTERNOON MLCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG. ZONE OF DEEP-LAYER FORCING FOR ASCENT PRECEDING MIDLEVEL SYSTEM COUPLED WITH PACIFIC FRONT AND TERRAIN INFLUENCES WILL SUPPORT UPSCALE GROWTH OF ONGOING STORMS INTO MULTIPLE BANDS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. EXPECT STORMS TO RAPIDLY MOVE/DEVELOP EWD/NEWD THROUGH THE CNTRL ROCKIES INTO NRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT WITH A CONTINUED RISK FOR MAINLY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. FOR ADDITIONAL NEAR TERM GUIDANCE...SEE WW 576.

sections.title: ERN DAKOTAS INTO UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: 12Z SOUNDINGS OVER THE DAKOTAS SHOWED A UNIFORMLY STRONG CAP IN PLACE AT THE BASE OF AN EML WHICH SHOULD SPREAD EWD ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY TODAY GIVEN THE LARGE-SCALE AIRFLOW REGIME. THIS CAP COUPLED WITH INCREASING HIGH CLOUDS FROM THE W/SW --AND THEIR POTENTIAL IMPACTS ON DAYTIME HEATING-- WILL LIKELY DELAY THE DEVELOPMENT OF SURFACE-BASED STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG COLD FRONT WHERE AIR MASS WILL BECOME MODERATELY TO EXTREMELY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE OF 2000-4000+ J/KG. LATEST CONVECTION-ALLOWING AND MESOSCALE MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THAT TSTMS WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY LIKELY BY 01/00Z OVER NWRN MN INTO ERN ND/NERN SD ON THE FRINGE OF THE STRONGER CAP. HERE...FORECAST HODOGRAPHS EXHIBIT VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILES WITH 30-40 KT OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WHICH WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS GIVEN THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY. WHILE VERY LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD...A TORNADO OR TWO IS POSSIBLE IN ADDITION TO DAMAGING WINDS. THE NOCTURNAL STRENGTHENING OF A SWLY LLJ MAY PROMOTE THE UPSCALE GROWTH OF STORMS INTO A FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS WITH A CONTINUED THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL SPREADING SEWD ACROSS NRN MN LATE TONIGHT INTO FRI MORNING.

sections.title: WI/MI/IND
sections.text: A BAND OF ELEVATED STORMS HAS RECENTLY FORMED OVER THE WRN UP OF MI INTO NERN WI ALONG THE EDGE OF THE CAP AND AT TERMINUS OF DIURNALLY WEAKENING LLJ. THERE IS SOME QUESTION AS TO WHETHER THIS ACTIVITY WILL PERSIST TODAY GIVEN THE WEAKENING LOW-LEVEL WAA/ISENTROPIC ASCENT WITH TIME. BUT...GIVEN THE VERY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND POTENTIALLY STRONG ELEVATED INSTABILITY UPSTREAM /REF. 12Z MPX SOUNDING/...HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH STORMS THAT CAN PERSIST. TONIGHT...AS MENTIONED ABOVE...EXPECT THE POTENTIAL FOR MCS FORMATION TO INCREASE ACROSS PARTS OF NRN WI AND THE UP OF MI WITH ADDITIONAL MORE ELEVATED TSTM ACTIVITY POSSIBLE DOWNSTREAM ACROSS LOWER MI INTO IND IN RESPONSE TO STRENGTHENING NOCTURNAL LLJ. THESE STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL INTO FRI MORNING.

sections.title: SRN GA/NRN FL
sections.text: STALLED SYNOPTIC FRONT AND DEVELOPING SEA BREEZE CIRCULATIONS WILL FOCUS NUMEROUS STORMS TODAY WITHIN A HIGH-PW AIR MASS WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR WET MICROBURST ACTIVITY OWING TO WATER LOADING EFFECTS.

sections.title: PORTIONS OF LOWER MS VALLEY INTO ERN OK/WRN AR
sections.text: WRN EXTENSION OF STALLED SURFACE FRONT ARCING NNWWD THROUGH THE REGION MAY SERVE AS THE FOCUS FOR ISOLATED DIURNAL STORM DEVELOPMENT. THE PRESENCE OF A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AND STEEPENING MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WITH NWD EXTENT WILL YIELD A MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS BY AFTERNOON WITH MLCAPE OF 1000-2000 J/KG SOUTH TO 2000-3500 J/KG NORTH. WHILE VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN RELATIVELY WEAK...THE POTENTIAL FOR SOME HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE GIVEN THE FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT.

sections.title: DEEP S TX
sections.text: NRN FRINGES OF T.S. ARLENE WILL CONTINUE TO AFFECT AREA TODAY WITH A SMALL RISK FOR A BRIEF TORNADO WITH LAND-FALLING RAINBANDS. ..MEAD/COHEN.. 06/30/2011

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM ERN UT/CO NEWD INTO MN
sections.text: ADJUSTED SEVERE PROBABILITIES BEHIND COLD FRONT ACROSS ERN UT AND REMOVED A PORTION OF W CNTRL WY WHERE LITTLE INSTABILITY REMAINS. FOR MORE INFORMATION SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1452. REMOVED LOW END WIND PROBS FROM MUCH OF FL WHERE MAINLY HEAVY RAIN IS ONGOING...AND SHIFTED INTO GA AND SRN SC WHERE LARGER DCAPE EXISTS AS WELL AS A MORE UNDISTURBED AIR MASS. FOR MORE INFORMATION SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1450. A CONDITIONAL THREAT OF SIGNIFICANT HAIL AND A TORNADO REMAINS OVER ERN ND INTO NWRN MN AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT. PERSISTENT DEEP LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE MAY OVERCOME CAPPING FOR A FEW SEVERE STORMS IN THIS AREA. OTHERWISE...EXPECT CONVECTION TO EMERGE INTO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS AN CONTINUE OVERNIGHT INTO THE DAKOTAS AHEAD OF EJECTING UPPER TROUGH WITH WIND AND HAIL THREAT. ..JEWELL.. 06/30/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1125 AM CDT THU JUN 30 2011/

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER-AIR PATTERN OVER CONUS WILL REMAIN DOMINATED BY STG RIDGING FROM SRN CA TO SRN PLAINS THEN NEWD ACROSS UPPER MS VALLEY/UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION...AND BROADLY CYCLONIC FLOW ACROSS PAC NW...GREAT BASIN AND NRN ROCKIES/PLAINS. MAIN SHORTWAVE TROUGH -- NOW EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY AND UPPER-AIR OBS OVER WRN CO AND 4-CORNERS AREA -- IS FCST TO DEAMPLIFY SOMEWHAT BUT ALSO ASSUME SLGT NEGATIVE TILT AS IT EJECTS NEWD ACROSS SERN WY AND NEB PANHANDLE BY 12Z. 23Z SFC ANALYSIS SHOWED ELONGATED AREA OF LOW PRESSURE OVER E-CENTRAL/NERN CO. THIS FEATURE SHOULD CONSOLIDATE/DEEPEN OVER SWRN/W-CENTRAL NEB THROUGH REMAINDER EVENING...NEAR TRAILING PORTION OF MCS DESCRIBED BELOW...MOVING NEWD OVER SAND HILLS OVERNIGHT. SPECIFIC LOCATION WILL BE INFLUENCED STRONGLY BY MESOBETA-SCALE PROCESSES SUCH AS CONVECTIVE COLD-POOL PRODUCTION. COLD FRONT...EVIDENT AT 23Z FROM SERN ND SWD ACROSS CENTRAL SD...IS EXPECTED TO DECELERATE AND BECOME QUASISTATIONARY AHEAD OF NEB MCS...OVER PORTIONS W-CENTRAL MN AND ERN THROUGH S-CENTRAL SD.

sections.title: CENTRAL ROCKIES TO CENTRAL/NRN HIGH PLAINS AND SD
sections.text: BAND OF SVR TSTMS IS BECOMING BETTER ORGANIZED ACROSS WRN NEB...AS IS ASSOCIATED COLD POOL...AHEAD OF EJECTING MID/UPPER LEVEL TROUGH. 5-6 MB PER 2-HR PRESSURE RISES AND STG COOLING HAS BEEN EVIDENT IN PAST COUPLE HOURS IN REAR-SIDE SFC OBSERVATIONS. REF SPC WW 578 AND RELATED MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR NOWCAST GUIDANCE OVER THIS REGION. FORCED ASCENT ALONG LEADING EDGE SHOULD OVERCOME REMAINING CAPPING TO MAINTAIN MCS AS IT MOVES INTO RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...WITH INSTABILITY GRADIENT ACCOMPANYING FRONTAL ZONE BEING ALIGNED CLOSELY WITH WINDS ALOFT AND ALSO SERVING AS PRIMARY FOCUS FOR MOST PROBABLE CORRIDOR OF FORWARD PROPAGATION. ACCORDINGLY..POTENTIAL IS INCREASING FOR ENHANCED SWATH OF DAMAGING GUSTS ACROSS SAND HILLS AND INTO PORTIONS SRN/CENTRAL SD THROUGH REMAINDER EVENING...WITH WIND PROBABILITIES ENHANCED ACCORDINGLY. MEANWHILE...TRAILING SMALL BANDS AND CLUSTERS OF TSTMS ACROSS CO ALSO POSE RISK OF DAMAGING GUSTS AS THEY MOVE THROUGH POCKETS OF FAVORABLE MOISTURE/INSTABILITY...PRIOR TO ENCOUNTERING COLD POOL FROM NEB COMPLEX. REF WW 577 AND RELATED MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR ADDITIONAL/NEAR-TERM GUIDANCE.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: CONDITIONAL POTENTIAL STILL EXISTS FOR TSTMS INCLUDING SUPERCELLS TO DEVELOP IN HIGH-CAPE BUT ALSO STRONGLY CAPPED ENVIRONMENT OVER NWRN MN...EXTREME SERN SD AND NERN SD. MAIN FACTOR IN INITIATION POTENTIAL WILL BE STRENGTH OF LOCALIZED FRONTAL FORCING....WITH BEST CHANCES FOR INITIATION IN NEXT 2-3 HOURS. THOUGH 00Z RAOBS DID NOT APPEAR TO SAMPLE THIS REGIME PARTICULARLY WELL...MODIFIED ABR SOUNDING AND RUC SOUNDINGS INDICATE MLCINH UNDER 25 J/KG OVER PORTIONS NWRN MN/SERN ND WITH MLCAPE IN 5000-6000 J/KG RANGE. WITH SUCH EXTREME INSTABILITY AVAILABLE AMIDST 35-45 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR...ANY TSTM THAT DOES FORM MAY BECOME SVR QUICKLY WITH LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING GUSTS AND PERHAPS A TORNADO. SOME WEAKNESSES IN MID-UPPER WINDS...COMBINED WITH RICHNESS OF MOISTURE -- I.E. SFC DEW POINTS COMMONLY 70S F AND 1.5-1.8 INCH PW -- INDICATE HEAVY-PRECIP MODES.

sections.title: LM AND ADJACENT AREAS
sections.text: PERSISTENT BAND OF TSTMS OVER LM MAY SHIFT/SPREAD SEWD OVER PORTIONS INDIANA...NERN/EXTREME ERN IL AND LOWER MI IN ZONE OF FAVORABLE LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AND WAA. LARGE/DAMAGING HAIL AND ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS MAY OCCUR PARTICULARLY NEAR SWRN FRINGE OF THIS COMPLEX. REF SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1456 AND WW 579 FOR ADDITIONAL/NEAR-TERM DETAILS.

sections.title: ARKLATEX REGION
sections.text: ISOLATED STG/DAMAGING DOWNBURSTS MAY STILL OCCUR FOR ANOTHER COUPLE HOURS...AS MULTICELLULAR TSTMS MOVE GENERALLY WWD/SWWD INTO WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYERS SUPPORTING STG EVAPORATIONAL DOWNDRAFT COOLING. THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH MARKEDLY AFTER ABOUT 03Z FROM COMBINATION OF GRADUAL DIABATIC SFC COOLING AND INCREASING COVERAGE OF AGGREGATED OUTFLOW AIR. ..EDWARDS.. 07/01/2011
